rules.rationale: This equation defines the named summary squareCeil(V) as the square of the mathematical ceiling of V.
This equation defines sumSquares as the zero-initialized invocation of its accumulator helper sumSquaresFrom.
This is the base defining equation for the accumulator recurrence: an empty remaining list returns the accumulator.
This is the inductive defining equation for sumSquaresFrom, consuming one list element and adding its ceiling-square to the accumulator.
